entities.title: Executable semantic fixtures
entities.summary: Each of the 94 scenarios needs concrete input values, the evaluation context and manifest, and an expected result envelope.
entities.details: The scenarios are requirements, not executable tests (conformance/README.md). A library may not reach 1.0.0 until it passes every semantic scenario for the profiles it claims (VERSIONING.md), so this gates every library's 1.0. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Every scenario in falsehoods.json and standards-convergence.json has inputs, a context and manifest, and an expected utv-result/1.0 envelope that a library's test runner can execute.
